editorial: Mac and Kelly Radner are finally ready to sell their house and move to the suburbs, but there is one big problem. A brand new sorority moves in next door, and these sisters party just as hard as the fraternity did last time. With their home sale on the line, Mac and Kelly team up with their old enemy Teddy to take down the sorority. The movie keeps the same silly energy as the first film while adding a fresh twist. You get plenty of wild party scenes, awkward moments, and funny banter between the grown-ups and the college kids. Seth Rogen and Rose Byrne are still a great comedy duo, and Zac Efron brings his usual charm. The sorority sisters also get some fun moments of their own. It is not as fresh as the original, but it still delivers plenty of laughs. If you enjoyed the first movie, you will likely have a good time here. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the Radners and Teddy try to stop the sorority from throwing a massive party that would ruin the house sale. After a chaotic battle, both sides realize they have been fighting for the wrong reasons. The sorority sisters decide to move out on their own terms, and the Radners finally sell their house. Teddy finds a new path in life, and everyone gets a happy ending. The movie ends on a warm, funny note with the families moving forward.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves raunchy comedies and party movies.
